messages:
Nina Gomez (recruiter): Heads-up: Cindy Wu (Data Eng candidate) is flying in for onsite on 2026-06-02. She needs a hotel night (arrive evening 6/1), shuttle from airport, and has a nut allergy. Also requested a quiet room for a coding assignment due to anxiety. Can people-ops lock these in?
Ethan Park (people ops): I can handle hotel and shuttle. Do we have a preferred hotel partner? How much for per-diem?
FacilitiesBot: Preferred hotel partner: Harborview Suites (discount code REDWOOD2026). Shuttle partners: CityRide (voucher) or reimbursed rideshare.
Nina Gomez (recruiter): Harborview is fine. Budget approved up to $200/night. Candidate prefers CityRide shuttle if available. I'll ask Cindy for flight arrival time and confirmation on hotel nights.
Cindy Wu (candidate): Thanks! Flight lands SFO 2026-06-01 20:10. Harborview works. Im fine with the company shuttle. Confirming I need a quiet, low-light room for the take-home coding (30-45 mins). Also prefer lactose-free breakfast.
Ethan Park (people ops): Booked Harborview 6/1 night under "Redwood Inference - candidate". Shuttle voucher reserved for pickup at arrivals kiosk; code emailed to candidate. Added "quiet low-light room" in special requests and lactose-free breakfast on request.
recruiter-bot: Attached: /forms/hotel-booking-confirmation.pdf :paperclip:
Nina Gomez (recruiter): Added 30-min pre-onboarding VM setup slot on 6/1 at 18:00. IT will provide a VM snapshot. Also adding note in calendar: nut allergy & lactose-free breakfast.
Ethan Park (people ops): FYI finance will need the invoice for hotel and shuttle; recruiter please forward receipts. Closing loop once receipts are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
notes: Onsite candidate travel, lodging, dietary restrictions, and quiet room accommodation for coding assignment. Includes booking confirmation and shuttle voucher instruction.
